name: Datepicker
description: A date selection input that displays a calendar grid popover on focus or click. Supports min/max date constraints, multiple sizes, and custom date formatting.

accessibility.role: dialog (calendar popover), grid (calendar grid), button (day cells)
notes: The input triggers a calendar popover on click or Enter/Space.
Arrow keys navigate the calendar grid by day (left/right) or week (up/down).
Escape closes the calendar popover and returns focus to the input.
Selected date is announced via aria-selected on the active day cell.
Focus indicator uses a 2px solid outline with var(--color-border-focus).
Disabled dates are marked with aria-disabled and are not focusable.

onChange.description: Callback fired when a date is selected or cleared.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown when no date is selected.

disabled.description: Disables the datepicker input and prevents opening the calendar.

size.description: Controls the input height, padding, and font size.

formatString.description: Date format string used to display the selected date in the input.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the root wrapper element.

do: Always provide an accessible label via aria-label or a linked FormLabel.
Set minDate and maxDate to constrain selection to valid date ranges.
Use the formatString prop to match the locale expectations of your users.
dont: Do not use for date-time selection — pair with Timepicker for time input.
Do not omit a label — provide aria-label if no visible label is present.
Do not set minDate after maxDate.
